issue_context.title: Improve `ChildBuilder` documentation to ensure a consistent style
issue_context.body:
## How can Bevy's documentation be improved?

The documentation added in #6035 is not great (see the suggestions at the bottom of the thread), but I decided to merge this relatively optimistically to help unblock an old PR.

We should clean up that documentation, and do a pass on all of the methods in that trait for consistency and clarity.

review_comments: :+1: I love when sentences are terminated with a dot.
What are the implications of adding `child` without checking? Could you add a line explaining why you should really not do it?

All I know about unchecked push is that might lead to the same entity appearing in the list twice. I don't know what problems that might cause. Mostly documented just to tell what's *not* checked, since function name `push_child_unchecked` doesn't really tell what checks it skips.
